filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections are strong, with authoritative sources like YC, TED, and Garry Tan for all topics. Arabic coverage is good but one topic, 'Scalability vs Traditional Business Models', had no eligible candidates due to hard gate failures (language, duration, views). For 'Idea Validation', the best Arabic candidate had already been used, so the next-best was chosen.
